headline: Major Gangnam 3-District Complexes Plunge: Banpo Down KRW 550 Million, Dogok Down KRW 210 Million
summary: Major complexes in Banpo and Dogok fell by KRW 550 million and KRW 210 million. Gangnam and Seocho prices have declined for six straight weeks amid weakening purchase demand.
why: Seoul apartment prices affect household wealth, mortgage risk and bank lending. Gangnam is the capital's most expensive residential district and a bellwether for the housing market.
